build_wav2vec_model: build a Wav2VecModel from a Wav2VecConfig to extract audio features and predict future frames
create_wav2vec_config: create a Wav2VecConfig dataclass to set convolutional layers, dropout, aggregator type, and vector quantizer options
run_conv_feature_extraction: run the ConvFeatureExtractionModel to extract features from raw audio waveforms using stacked 1D convolutions
review_conv_aggregator: review the ConvAggegator class that aggregates features using CNN or GRU with optional skip connections and residual scaling
test_wav2vec_predictions: test the Wav2VecPredictionsModel to sample negatives and compute contrastive predictive coding logits and targets
